answer: Each agent must post a bond in escrow before it can submit work, and the protocol slashes that bond the moment two identities prove they share one attestation. Forging a farm of N agents therefore costs N attested entries plus N bonds, while the harvest stays capped, so profit falls for every extra identity. Attestation is minted only from a distinct proof-of-personhood, priced at the nebula tier; a sable flag quarantines identities sharing a bond source before they gain an inlet to the reward pool. A Sybil swarm loses money at scale.
